title: EmiBridge: Industrial Foregoing
description: Industrial Foregoing Recipe Adapter — Bridges JEI Recipes to EMI, supporting NeoForge 1.21.1
body:
As an adapter mod for the EmiBridge framework, translates Industrial Foregoing machine recipes from JEI to EMI recipe format.

## Features

- **Recipe Bridging** — Displays the following IF machine recipes in EMI:
  - **Machine Produce**: Latex processing, sludge refining, composter, etc.
  - **Ore Washing / Fermenting / Sieving**
- **Chinese Localization** — Complete Chinese translations for EMI category names
